name: Mersheen
bio: Part mermaid, part Pusheen. His wife since July 7, 2024. Brings the sparkle.

name: Dino Brown
bio: A bear in a dinosaur suit, most days. Iceland, Hawaii, flowerpot desserts. Always up for it.

name: Gunnersaurus
bio: Arsenal’s mascot, pocket-sized. Shares his pandan, reluctantly.

name: Miffy
bio: Quiet. Punctual. Always in the lineup.

name: Ricky
bio: A frog in a cape. Came to Italy, New Zealand and the pumpkin patch.

name: The minis
bio: Two tiny dinosaur-cats. Climb on him at the beach, ride along on snow days. Possibly related.
